value.rationale: The distinct parity-dependent high-activity precision signs expose a structural difference between odd-order near-perfect matchings (one monomer, finite star variance) and even-order perfect matchings (two-monomer fluctuations, collapsing star variance). Adjusting for every other edge reverses the disjoint-edge relationship as activity changes for all odd n>=5. Exact coefficients and an all-n existence transition answer a natural dependence question beyond elementary scalar covariances.
